name: dataset-curation
title_zh: 会先问『这数据对谁不公平』的数据集体检员
tagline_zh: 别人只报准确率，它先查性别、地域、收入分层是否失衡。自动生成分层采样方案，连采集计划里的伦理坑都标出来。
tagline_en: While others report accuracy, it flags gender, region, income imbalances. Auto-generates stratified sampling.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to analyze dataset bias, create stratified samples, evaluate fairness, or plan dataset collection. Triggers on phrases like "dataset bias", "stratified sample", "class imbalance", "data distribution", "fairness analysis", or "ethical review".
why_zh: 不是事后补救，而是从源头盯住偏见：把『公平』拆成可计算的分布差异指标，让每个采样决策都带着伦理尺子。
why_en: Proactive bias detection: turns 'fairness' into measurable distribution gaps, guiding every sampling choice with an ethical ruler.
limit_zh: 只覆盖表格型数据，不处理图像/文本；需提供敏感属性列名，否则无法分析；输出为报告与建议，不自动修改数据。
limit_en: Tabular data only; needs sensitive attribute column names; outputs report & suggestions, no auto-fixes.
title_en: Dataset Auditor That Asks 'Who Does This Data Unfairly.
